idea: A 45-45-90 triangle has sides s, s, s2​. A 30-60-90 triangle has sides s, s3​, 2s, with the shortest side opposite 30°. Equilateral triangles split into two 30-60-90 triangles, and squares into two 45-45-90 triangles.
trap: Putting 3​ on the side opposite 30°.
desmos: These answers have radicals; Desmos gives decimals. Knowing the side patterns gets you the exact form.

items.stem: A square has a diagonal of length 122​. What is the area of the square?
items.explain: A diagonal splits the square into two 45-45-90 triangles, so the side is 12 and the area is 122=144.
